prompt: One complete NEW AUTUMN WOODLAND entrance ground map in Pokemon Mystery Dungeon Explorers of Sky DS pixel-art style. Use the attached original D24P11A ROM forest as the reference for native-scale leaf clusters, trunks, roots, grass and texture, NOT its straight path layout. Autumn is an INVENTED seasonal reinterpretation, not an official ROM scene. Landscape 4:3, 1200 by 896 pixels, elevated top-down PMD ground-map camera, no sky or horizon. Many medium-sized overlapping deciduous trees with muted COPPER-BROWN, BRONZE and warm OCHRE foliage, olive-green undergrowth, brown trunks and scattered brown leaves. Warm but restrained palette: foliage midtones roughly RGB 160 125 45, dark brown shadows and olive bronze highlights, NOT vivid orange, saturated red or glowing yellow. Reuse the reference's warm bark-and-earth colour family for this autumn variation. Native DS small shaded pixel clusters, not thick black ink outlines or smooth flat tree blobs. Create a NEW asymmetric SLOPING woodland trail: a broad irregular ochre-brown dirt approach enters from the SOUTH centre, bends LEFT through the lower-middle, opens into a wide mossy clearing in the middle, then bends gently RIGHT to reach the upper-centre forest edge. The trail continues visibly through the NORTH edge between receding trees, not a door, cave mouth or flat black hole. Keep at least a third of the lower frame open as grassy/mossy ground plus earth path. Richly textured earthy ground with fine leaf litter, NOT a perfectly flat beige or lime fill, no brick paving. LEFT side has a deeper dense stand of trees and roots; RIGHT side has a more open uneven low fern border and several trees. Trees and forest terrain extend OFF all four corners, full-frame immersion, no diorama outline, no blank exterior margins or symmetrical tree ring. No obstacle on the central path. Tiny ferns and sparse mushrooms only near the side roots, no central landmark. No cliffs, mountains, water, structures, stairs, altar, shrine, symbols, crystals, magical glow, fog overlay, sun beams, Pokemon, characters, items, text or UI. Single full-frame map.
palette_note: Saison automnale inventee, le rip source reste vert. Les tons chauds du bois et du sol servent de diagnostic, pas de preuve de feuillage officiel. Le chemin garde un aspect de terre dallee et sa courbe n’est pas exactement celle demandee ; aucune approbation artistique supposee.
